# A01 EGIA stage reader fixture

`valid_egia.json` freezes the seven-stage EGIA core and its seven local evidence edges from the EGIA owner's `tests/egia/test_stages.py::_graph` at the A01 implementation. The fixture is copied into a fresh IsOS starter graph by `tests/reader_features_cli.py`; its link gateway port is changed to the selected EOS gRPC default `16200` before Validate and Apply. The selected owner catalog supplies the stage descriptors and all 23 data schemas.

The replay proves exact selected-type rejection before catalog, routing only for the two A04 owner pairs, fixed-port denial, successful real-owner Validate/Apply and exact `egia/stages.json` revision bytes, and Run/Restart rejection of a changed selected overlay before child spawn. It uses a clean `ISOS_HOME` and leaves source checkouts unchanged. Build EOS and IsOS, then run `ISOS_REAL_EGIA_ROOT=/absolute/path/to/EGIA-A04 ISOS_BIN=/absolute/path/to/isos PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest -q reader_features_cli.ReaderFeaturesReplay.test_real_egia_stage_catalog_routes_only_evidence_and_denies_fixed_edges reader_features_cli.ReaderFeaturesReplay.test_real_egia_stage_apply_pins_exact_owner_overlay reader_features_cli.ReaderFeaturesReplay.test_real_egia_scheduler_loss_rejects_restart_before_old_child_stop`.

A04 extends this fixture without changing its saved bytes: only the resource and observations pairs are selected evidence routes. The real-owner replay accepts priority on resource, rejects priority on context snapshot and graph-wired fixed admission, and rejects a missing selected `egia-evidence-scheduler-v1` on both Run and Restart without changing the prior process PIDs or saved bytes. Use the merged EGIA A04 owner, not the earlier A01 build.

The A01 compatibility replay uses merged EGIA `d7d342e` without `routed_edges`: set `ISOS_REAL_EGIA_A01_ROOT` and run `reader_features_cli.ReaderFeaturesReplay.test_real_a01_owner_stays_design_only_and_can_run`. It proves design-only Validate/Apply/Run with no selected EGIA runtime process, and exact QoS rejection with unchanged saved bytes.

The selected-catalog replay extends `test_real_egia_stage_apply_pins_exact_owner_overlay`: after Apply, HTTP `GET /node-types/selected` must match the saved-byte revision, include exactly the seven owner stages and 23 EGIA schemas, and expose `settings[].data_type` for the editor. `GET /node-graph` must report that same revision and remain editable. The selected endpoint performs no graph write.
